Ken Webb, who joined the R.A.F. and went to Canada and collected three stripes, is, we understand, back in England, doing his stuff! Max Quackenbos must be feeling dizzy after the Indoor Season, running on a board track eleven laps to the mile.
Max Quackenbos, now settled in New Jersey, sends greetings and regrets he was unable to get over for the Games.

The friends of Max Quackenbos will be pleased to learn that he is now a proud father—a girl. " Quack " (our pre-war Junior Captain) does no competitive running now and marvels at how some of his old friends keep it up.
